requirements.title: Merged delivery reviews the integrated source

source.excerpt:
Capability `evidence.merged-delivery.v1` makes explicit-locator delivery checks
use the provider-observed integration commit when the MR/PR is merged.

requirements.rationale: Provider source-head identity and integrated checkout identity have different roles; same-tree commit differences are valid, unreviewed content and unavailable integration metadata are not.

criteria.expected: Merged delivery checks the actual integrated tree while locators retain the provider source head. Same-tree distinct commits pass; wrong locators, different trees, missing integration metadata/objects and pre-merge review substitution fail.
